    Gibbs sampler for post–synthetic-control hierarchical models (internal)

    gibbs_sampling.Rd

    Runs the full Gibbs sampler for the second-stage Bayesian model used by scmBayesPost when moderator and/or endogeneity components are present. This function is internal and is called by gibbs_postscm().

    gibbs_sampling(
  gdata,
  n_iter = 1000,
  burn_in = 500,
  run_selection_gibbs = FALSE,
  do.CF = TRUE,
  selection.method = c("2SRI", "GR"),
  Z_cov_dense = FALSE,
  CF.interactions = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    gdata

    A data object produced by prepare_data_general(). Must contain at least Y_block, X_block, and W. For second-stage models it must also contain Z_block and, if IV functionality is used, Z.instruments.

    n_iter

    Integer; total number of Gibbs iterations.

    burn_in

    Integer; number of initial iterations discarded as burn-in.

    run_selection_gibbs

    Logical; if TRUE, include a Gibbs block for a binary treatment/selection equation and update the relevant column of X_block with the resulting residual (2SRI) or generalized residual (GR). Requires gdata$first_stage components (e.g., GRX, GRY) and a column in X_block corresponding to the residual (typically "GR").

    do.CF

    Logical; if TRUE, apply a control-function approach when gdata$Z.instruments is provided (append first-stage residuals, optionally interacted). If FALSE, use a 2SLS-style replacement with first-stage predicted values. Ignored when no instruments are provided.

    selection.method

    Character; residual type used in the selection block: "2SRI" uses probit residual inclusion; "GR" uses generalized residuals.

    Z_cov_dense

    Logical; if TRUE, estimate a dense covariance matrix for the first-stage IV residuals (requires MCMCpack for inverse-Wishart draws); if FALSE, assumes a diagonal covariance.

    CF.interactions

    Logical; if TRUE and do.CF = TRUE, include interaction terms among control-function residuals.

    Value

    A list of posterior draws. Components include (depending on model):

    beta_samples

    Matrix of draws for stacked second-stage coefficients.

    gamma_samples

    Matrix of draws for moderator effects.

    sigma2_samples

    Vector of draws for outcome noise variance.

    tau_samples

    Matrix of draws for hierarchical scale parameters.

    beta_fs_samples

    (Optional) draws for selection-equation coefficients.

    sigma2_fs_samples

    (Optional) draws for selection-equation variance.

    beta.Z_samples

    (Optional) list of draws for IV first-stage coefficients.

    sigma.Z_samples

    (Optional) draws for IV covariance (diagonal or dense).

    Details

    The sampler targets a hierarchical regression of treated-unit (or unit–event) treatment-effect parameters on moderator covariates, with optional endogeneity correction via (i) a selection-equation Gibbs block for binary treatment assignment, and/or (ii) instrumental-variables/control-function blocks for endogenous moderators.

    See also

    gibbs_postscm(), prepare_data_general()
